text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell tool here. I read each test and checked the fixes against it by hand, so please run the suite to confirm.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. It was 3.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` now includes `Emma` (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). The Austen details are my own, since the tests only check the title.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from a module that doesn't exist.

I didn't touch the tests.
